programs.title: Nazi Megastructures
programs.desc:
In their quest for world domination, during World War II, Germany constructed advanced military equipment, created deadly technologies, and built powerful defensive fortifications.Engineers working for the Nazis designed modern weapons, including those of mass destruction.The authors of the program present the most ambitious military projects.They tell the story of people working on weapons and other strategic inventions that were supposed to ensure the victory of the Third Reich.Although the Nazis ultimately lost the war, the military technologies created by their scientists proved groundbreaking
This is the story of one of the most far-reaching operations of World War II - the German occupation and fortification of Norway.It was to become an Arctic stronghold from which the Nazis could attack the Soviet Union.Hitler also drew attention to another aspect: the country's natural resources were important for another strategic goal - building an atomic war, which would ensure his victory in the war.When the Germans occupied Norway in 1940, they started building air bases, fortifications and training centers there.
